messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: ACME asked for a private-tenant pilot with customer HSM + burst prewarm targeted for May 18. Need runtime/infra/security alignment on launch criteria by EOW.
Aj (Eng): Quick Q — strict HSM in-customer VPC or can we host KMS as fallback? Lead time differs a lot.
Maya (Product): They insisted on HSM in their VPC (air-gapped). Also want ~5k QPS burst during a scheduled demo. If we can't promise that they won't sign the pilot.
Rene (Runtime): Runtime constraints: 5k burst in private means prewarm across multiple pods + model quantization plan. Naive prewarm will be very costly. Need clarity on latency SLOs during burst.
Sam (Infra): From infra side: we'll need a ticket with network diagrams, IAM policies, and exact HSM vendor. Also confirm dedicated GPU pool vs shared dedicated — provisioning differs (2–3 weeks vs ~3 days).
Priya (Security): Security flag: HSM in-customer introduces compliance requirements. We'll need HSM attestation, key lifecycle docs, and audit logging before we greenlight.
Aj (Eng): Proposal for MVP acceptance criteria (initial):
- HSM connectivity validated (attestation + key rotation smoke)
- Dedicated GPU pool sized for steady-state 1k rps + documented burst prewarm policy
- Latency targets: P50 < 80ms, P95 < 300ms under pilot load
- Canary and rollback plan documented
- Security attestation signed
Anything missing?
Maya (Product): Add: customer must run a representative prompt set and we must run evals to ensure no quality regressions after any quantization. Also agree on a cost upper bound for the pilot.
Rene (Runtime): Agree. For quantization tests I'll start with 4-bit and KV cache tuning. I'll deliver a perf matrix and profiles by Tue. Example perf harness we plan to run:
```bash
# perf harness example
python perf.py --model redwood-v1 --quant 4bit --seq 2048 --batch 8
```
Sam (Infra): I'll open the infra ticket and tag @networking-team. Need exact CIDR ranges and HSM vendor/vendor API docs — Maya can you add when ACME sends them?
Maya (Product): Yes — CIDR and vendor will come from ACME. I'll post to the ticket once they share, ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): :lock: Security asks in advance: 1) HSM attestation doc, 2) rolling key rotation plan, 3) access approvals matrix, 4) audit log sink + retention. We can do a 2-week expedited review if those are complete.
Aj (Eng): Suggested sequence: (1) Security checklist completed, (2) Infra staging + prewarm plan, (3) Runtime perf & quant tests, (4) Canary on dedicated pool, (5) Pilot. Can we map owners to those steps?
Maya (Product): Owners: Security -> Priya; Infra -> Sam; Runtime -> Rene; Eng lead/delivery -> Aj; Product -> Maya. I'll attach owners in the ticket and set weekly checkpoints.
deploy-bot: canary-plan created: canary/privpilot/acme-1758234567 by Aj. Policy: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over three windows. See /deploys for details.
Aj (Eng): One more gap — fallback if HSM network fails during demo. Need a scripted fallback (degrade to hosted KMS + customer notification) and manual approval flow.
Priya (Security): Fallback is acceptable only with customer's signed waiver. Maya, can you confirm ACME would accept that?
Maya (Product): I'll check today. If they refuse fallback we need a contingency: run their HSM in staging at least 72 hours before demo.
Rene (Runtime): I'll prioritize the perf matrix and add a "failure-mode" run with cold KV cache to capture worst-case latency/regressions.
Sam (Infra): I'll estimate capacity and share cost delta for on-demand rooftop prewarm vs reserved capacity by EOD Fri.
Maya (Product): Thanks all. Action items recap: Maya -> confirm HSM vendor + customer waiver; Sam -> infra ticket, CIDR, capacity estimate; Rene -> perf matrix + failure-mode runs; Priya -> security checklist; Aj -> rollback/fallback playbook. Checkpoint next Wed 10am. :calendar:
